title: 7 Relaxing Short Anime Perfect For Beginners
content: The ever-growing popularity of the anime industry has many curious people looking to venture into the world of exciting series. However, considering the number of series out there, with many of them being long-running or having multiple seasons, choosing the right series for you can be overwhelming.
author: ComicBook

title: Star Wars Reveals Packed Staff & Cast for New Anime Series
content: Star Wars is readying for the debut of its first full anime series later this Summer, and has revealed the talented production staff and voice cast behind it all. Star Wars and anime have been a great match so far as fans have gotten to see through three volumes of the official anthology series, Star Wars: Visions.
author: ComicBook

title: Naruto: Every Akatsuki Member Ranked From Worst to Best
content: The Akatsuki are one of the most iconic villain groups in anime history , right alongside the likes of Hunter x Hunter ‘s Phantom Troupe and Bleach’s Espada. Almost every member has way more character than most Shonen villains.
author: ComicBook

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, June 22-28
content: The television ratings above are an estimate of the percentage of the population that watch a given program, based on data from a survey of households in Japan's Kanto region. The ratings do not count recordings that viewers watch later.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle’s Disappointing Record Could Trouble the Anime Film Industry
content: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle might just be the biggest anime film ever released. It has broken nearly every record an anime film has achieved, emerging not only as the most successful anime movie of 2025 but also as a film capable of competing with major Hollywood titles.
author: ComicBook

title: Otakon 2026 Hosts Voice Actress Ayaka Fukuhara, I.G. USA's President Maki Terashima-Furuta
content: The staff of Otakon announced on Sunday it will host voice actress Ayaka Fukuhara ( Captain Tsubasa , Sakura Wars ) and president of Production I.G. USA Maki Terashima-Furuta , at this year's event.
author: ANN

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Reveals Episode 1 Opening Video Featuring OP Song by Yuiko Ohara
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 1 opening video featuring the theme song by Yuiko Ohara. Crunchyroll will be streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
author: Anime Corner

title: My Girlfriend's Friend TV Anime Reveals Teaser Video, More Staff Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Jura's My Girlfriend's Friend ( Kanojo no Tomodachi ) manga revealed the anime's teaser promotional video, second key visual, and additional staff members on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Shinya Komi's Sora o Matotte Manga Ends on July 15
content: Manga creator Shinya Komi revealed on July 2 that the Sora o Matotte (To Drape Over the Sky) manga will end in the next issue of Shueisha 's Grand Jump magazine on July 15. The manga centers on high school student Haro Ogawa.
author: ANN

title: 29 Years Later, One Piece Finally Settles The Zoro vs Sanji Debate
content: The highly anticipated Elbaph Arc in One Piece takes a turn for the worse with the unexpected arrival of the Holy Knights . Luffy and his crew were welcomed warmly in the fabled Land of the Giants, but the celebration didn’t last long after the villains showed up and targeted the children.
author: ComicBook
